items.a: Yes. The boutique is open by appointment only, so your stylist’s attention is entirely yours. Appointments run from one to two hours.

The **One-Hour** ($25) suits brides who already know what they love. The **Two-Hour** ($50) gives you time to try every silhouette. The **Champagne VIP** ($125) reserves the entire boutique for two hours, with champagne for you and up to 6 guests.

items.q: How many guests can I bring?
items.a: Up to 4 guests for a standard appointment and up to 6 for a VIP appointment. We kindly ask that no children under 12 attend.

items.q: Do I choose the gowns I try on?
items.a: Yes. You’ll choose roughly 8–12 gowns from the showroom, and your stylist will add a few she thinks you shouldn’t miss.

Nude or skin-tone undergarments (silicone nipple covers, high-waisted shapewear or underwear) — your stylist will help you in and out of each gown. Bring the people whose opinion you trust, and an open mind; brides are often surprised by the silhouette they choose.

items.q: Can I come back for a second look?
items.a: Of course. Book the complimentary 30-minute Return Visit for a second look, to place your order, or to collect your gown.
Gowns range from $1,500 to $6,000, with most between $2,500 and $3,000.

Bridal sizing runs about two sizes smaller than street sizing — if you usually wear a 6, expect a bridal 10 or larger. Every designer sizes differently, and your stylist will measure you to order the right size.

items.q: What size are the boutique samples?
items.a: Most of our samples are sizes 10–16.
Yes. Eva Lendel, Luce Sposa and our Soirée collection are available in plus sizes.
Nine to twelve months before your wedding. Most gowns are made to order — the designer begins your gown once you place the order — and you’ll want time for alterations afterwards.

items.q: Is my gown made to measure?
items.a: Most gowns are made to order, not made to measure: they’re produced in a standard size and then tailored to you by a seamstress.
Almost certainly. Very few gowns fit perfectly on arrival. Allow an additional 2–3 months for alterations.
We don’t offer in-house alterations, but we’re happy to recommend trusted seamstresses in the area.
Payment is made in full when you place your order.
All sales are final — no refunds or exchanges. You’ll review and sign a sales agreement when you order.
Two hours with the entire boutique reserved for you and up to 6 guests, with champagne. It is $125 and is booked like any other appointment.

items.q: Can I book a private appointment?
items.a: Yes — the Champagne VIP is our private appointment. No other bride shops while you’re here.
